next.reason: §2023:12.4.6.4.4 GR2 restates the shared record area, simultaneous opens, the record of each output file and of the most recently-read input file, and 'an implicit redefinition of the area with records aligned on the leftmost byte position'. Its file-area exception and availability sentences follow from 1985's SAME AREA precedence and OPEN/CLOSE. WRITE GR4 and RELEASE GR3 restate the 1985 WRITE/RELEASE rules, not this one.
